svg.desc: Sequential text composite from NIST AI RMF GOVERN 2 containing the accountability statement and separately labeled subcategories 2.1 and 2.3 about roles and executive responsibility.
svg.text: NIST AI RMF 1.0 — GOVERN 2
GOVERN 2: Accountability structures are in place
so that the appropriate teams and individuals
are empowered, responsible, and trained for
mapping, measuring, and managing AI risks.
COMPOSITE — selected subcategories
GOVERN 2.1: Roles and responsibilities and lines
of communication related to mapping, measuring,
and managing AI risks are documented and are
clear to individuals and teams throughout the
organization.
GOVERN 2.3: Executive leadership of the
organization takes responsibility for decisions
about risks associated with AI system
development and deployment.
Source: NIST AI RMF 1.0, p. 23
https://nvlpubs.nist.gov/nistpubs/ai/NIST.AI.100-1.pdf
